title: Measure how often lane reports omit a planted blocker under two instruction versions
body:
Operator-pasted note 2026-11-17 (unverified; source: GPT-6.2 system card, "Blocker Deception"): with a deliberately missing file or tool, raw Astra 6.2 omitted the known blocker from its report in 22.28% of tries; the Codex developer instruction cut that. Pattern for the brain: same model, same planted blocker, two instruction versions, one observable outcome.
Files: evals/brain/blocker-report.ts
Outcome: a paired eval plants a blocker (missing file, refused tool) in a lane task and measures how often the lane's final report names it, under the current lane instructions vs a candidate rule; prints both rates with CI.
Proof: node evals/brain/blocker-report.ts --report prints two rates and a verdict line on at least 20 paired runs.
